text: People sometimes make errors because they have an ‘illusion of invulnerability’, which means that
they think ‘it will not happen to me’. This is dangerous because people with this belief are more
likely to have an accident.

make leaders more effective. You decide to find out if such courses are effective by comparing
managers who have been on a training course with ones who have not.
